picks.title: Using agents in Figma Design (and coming soon to FigJam and Slides)
picks.excerpt: Figma's own walkthrough of working with agents inside Figma Design, with FigJam and Slides support flagged as next. It is the clearest official statement yet of how the agent is meant to sit inside an existing design file rather than replace it.
picks.rationale: Figma's own account of how agents work inside a design file — the single most actionable thing a designer can try tomorrow.

picks.title: Autodesk is discontinuing Mudbox, its digital sculpting software
picks.excerpt: Sales of the Academy Award-winning sculpting tool end this November. A long-standing part of many hard-surface and character pipelines is being retired, forcing teams onto ZBrush, Blender or Autodesk's newer generative 3D bets.
picks.rationale: A dated end-of-sale that forces a real tooling decision in any pipeline still carrying Mudbox.

picks.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 now available on Vercel AI Gateway
picks.excerpt: xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2.0 is now on Vercel AI Gateway as a preview: an image generation and editing model that plans typography and layout together and renders small text sharply. Typography-aware generation is exactly the failure mode that has kept most image models out of real layout work.
picks.rationale: Typography-and-layout-aware generation is the exact gap that kept image models out of layout work, and it is available behind an API today.

picks.title: Animating CSS border-image
picks.excerpt: Border-image slices can run across an entire element border, and animating them produces effects that are hard to get any other way. A craft technique agents almost never reach for on their own.
picks.rationale: A concrete craft technique that generated UI never reaches for — usable the same afternoon.

picks.title: Bring Animated Maya Scenes To Blender & UE5 Instantly
picks.excerpt: MableLink moves animated Maya scenes into Blender and Unreal Engine 5 in one click, with materials carried over and live re-sync on the Pro tier. Interchange friction is one of the least glamorous but most expensive costs in a 3D pipeline.
picks.rationale: One-click Maya→Blender/UE5 transfer with live re-sync removes a daily, expensive interchange tax; second render pick so it takes a distinct palette accent.
